title: The Great Furnace of Grymforge
summary: Reveals Adamantine Forge instructions and advances its quest.

fields.Read: The book begins under the Flumph Mating Rituals disguise. A successful check or Sussur Bloom lifts the illusion. It advances the Adamantine Forge quest. Verify the Memory Shard and Scribbled Notes too to earn If I Can’t Have It… for Sages.
fields.Forge: Place Mithral Ore in the crucible and a mould in its chamber. Lower the hammer, open the lava valve and drop the hammer again.
fields.Acquisition: Xargrim’s corpse in the hidden Ebonlake Grotto room, (49, −72).

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
